entry.title: fuck life
entry.content:
are you reading that? well, I guess you are something

I didn't meant you was nothing, we are all some kind of things

I mean, you know how to read, 1000%, but we used to read fast, we skim the text, we no more read

that's not a tutorial, that's just some non sense text I wrote, to talk to myself

I don't know how you ended up here, but it's some kind of miracle, why?, because I said so, in that simple way

everything around you is a miracle, you restrict yourself from seeing it, no?, well, then you are a miracle, more rare than a black hole (every human is)

I'm talking non sense? at least I tried to say something meaningful, and I guess I'm enjoying trying

sometimes I see people saying that they are sad, I wonder, why?

not why they say things like that, or why they are sad

but why they enjoy looking vulnerable, it's just, people enjoy being 'underdog', but they never try to win in the other hand

I guess, seeking attention is a coping mechanism for weak individuals to make sure their group will help them

or not?, It's just I hate people who loves being victims of their past, because it's all on your head, move on

you will ask, if you are good, why you want people to be better than you?, it's just, iron sharpens iron, what you expected me to say?, "I don't feel good while I'm alone" ?

I do feel good all time, it's a choice, and when I don't feel good, I remember that I should feel good, and I do

every second, life is shorter than ever, so, what you choose? to feel good? or to choose what is usual

"fuck life", is just some kind of playful phrase I say to myself when I find myself drifting away, but I really love that gift called 'life'
